lines.text: Two gods once raced to find the end of a pillar of fire. Neither of them ever did.

parts.text: Two gods once raced to find the end of a pillar of fire.

lines.text: Brahma and Vishnu were arguing. Which of us is the greatest?

parts.text: Which of us is the greatest?

lines.text: Suddenly, a pillar of fire split the darkness between them. No top. No bottom.

parts.text: Suddenly, a pillar of fire split the darkness between them.

lines.text: Brahma became a swan, and flew up. Vishnu became a boar, and dug down.

parts.text: Brahma became a swan, and flew up.
Vishnu became a boar, and dug down.

lines.text: A thousand years passed. The fire just kept going.
Then the pillar opened. And Shiva stepped out, smiling.
You cannot measure the infinite. You can only bow to it.

parts.text: You can only bow to it.
